title: Replace obsolete thread and in-process stream specifications
description:
Translate the three computerless-turn stories into executable feature files before production code changes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Use channel and turn terminology; there is no separate thread object.
- Specify turn-scoped SSE and durable replay rather than an in-process subscription.
- Require tenant_id on every bot, channel, message, turn, and job fixture.
- Run Behave and confirm each new scenario fails for the expected missing behavior.
- Remove or rewrite contradictory scenarios instead of supporting both designs.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
# Implementation plan (manager)

Specs only. No production control-plane HTTP, no DynamoDB, no model loop. Do not extend RealtimeSubscription / TurnStream to "make scenarios pass."

## Stories to encode (Gherkin is the product narrative)

From Kanbus, not from the old feature files:

1. chatticus-031cf4 — Address a named bot without starting a computer
   - Channel with a named bot; computer is stopped.
   - Text-only message; bot completes one turn; one durable bot answer; computer stays stopped.
   - Cross-tenant post/read denied; channel unchanged.

2. chatticus-d41132 — Watch one active turn through server-sent events
   - Coalesced progress chunks in order; one terminal event; stream ends with the turn; no connection remains for the channel or tab.

3. chatticus-e11f32 — Reconnect without becoming part of the turn
   - After drop, replay committed events after a cursor; turn completes whether or not a watcher remains.

## What to do to the repo

- Rewrite features/messages.feature: channel not thread; tenant_id on every fixture; addressing enqueues a turn whose required capabilities are NOT hardcoded to computer (cpu-only is enough). Keep bot-to-bot and file-path-in-message if they still match MESSAGING.md; use channel language.
- Replace features/realtime_api.feature: no in-process subscription, no subscribe_realtime, no turn stream tokens as kernel methods. Specify GET /turns/{id}/stream semantics as behavior: ordered chunks, terminal event, after=seq replay of committed events, watcher absence does not stop the turn.
- Step definitions: fail with missing-behavior errors for the new durable/computerless/SSE-as-store assertions. Delete or rewrite steps that only exist to drive TurnStream / RealtimeSubscription. One correct path — do not keep a thread API alongside a channel API.
- python tests that encode thread.message.created / TurnStream must not remain the spec. If test_messaging.py is the old doodle, mark it or rewrite so CI is not asserting the rejected design as success. Prefer: old passing tests that lock the rejected API are deleted or changed so they no longer pass the obsolete path. Routing/approval/snapshot features stay.
- From python/: behave must run. New computerless/SSE scenarios FAIL (pending is not failure — they must fail for expected missing behavior, or be @wip only if behave treats wip as skip — acceptance says FAIL). Existing snapshot/routing scenarios still PASS.

## Do not

- Implement DynamoDB or Lambda in this task.
- Add AppSync or WebSocket.
- Dual-read thread and channel.
- Emojis.
- Close this issue until behave demonstrates the split: old contradictions gone, new scenarios failing for the right reason.

## Git

Branch: cursor/computerless-gherkin-4a21
Push origin. Do not merge.

Specs on cursor/computerless-gherkin-4a21 were accepted. They now also live on cursor/durable-computerless-turn-4a21 (341e42e) with HTTP SSE steps that speak GET /turns/{id}/stream as text/event-stream via a local uvicorn front door.

Do not merge Gherkin alone. Merge Gherkin + implementation together after the durable-turn task is accepted. Do not close this issue until that merge is on main and CI behave is green there.
